title: Nonnegative k-Schur-positive algebra morphisms parametrized by k-rectangle values
author: Cédric Lecouvey; Pierre Tarrago
work: Alcove random walks, k-Schur functions and the minimal boundary of the k-bounded partition poset
difficulty_reason: The boundary parametrization requires the author’s finite rectangle-field extension, primitive-element construction and irreducible Perron-Frobenius specialization to obtain the positive branch. Beyond these spectral and algebraic steps, the complete selected proof must extend that branch across reducible boundary matrices by placing bounded connected cluster sets inside finite algebraic fibers, and use Hopf convolution to establish density of positive morphisms. This coupled algebraic, spectral and topological construction is substantially beyond ordinary doctoral qualification exercises.
